The person behind the pixels

Curious by nature.
A maker by
happy accident.

I'm Cris, a media relations professional in Gatineau, Québec, with a growing collection of app ideas and a soft spot for pixel art.

I like turning everyday routines—reading, writing, collecting ideas—into little experiences that feel personal. I explore code, design, and AI to see what I can bring to life.

Currently: making things, learning French, and finding the details that make a screen feel a little more human.
